dossier.title: Canister Recovery
briefing: We had a canister go adrift during transfer here at {HERE}. I cannot spare anyone to retrieve it, and you are the closest pilot with the skills to do it. Find the canister, scoop it up, and return it to this station. I am {PATRON}, and I can make this worth your while if you succeed.

find.arrive: RECOVERY: SCOOP THE CANISTER ADRIFT AT {TARGET}
find.success: Canister scooped and secure in hold at {TARGET}.
find.fail: Failed to recover canister at {TARGET} before deadline.

home.arrive: RECOVERY: BRING THE CANISTER BACK TO {TARGET}
home.success: Canister delivered to {TARGET}; recovery mission complete.
home.fail: Recovery aborted; canister not returned to {TARGET}.

dossier.lead: {PATRON} at {WORLD} has a recovery job waiting - a canister went adrift.

rumour.far: {PATRON} at {WORLD} is recruiting a pilot for a recovery job - canister retrieval.
rumour.near: From {PATRON} at {WORLD}: canister adrift during transfer, please retrieve it urgently.

dossier.news: {PATRON} at {WORLD} has posted a recovery contract for an adrift canister.

story.opening: Day {DAY} at {WORLD}: Commander accepted the recovery contract and set course outbound.

closing.complete: Day {DAY} at {WORLD}: Canister recovered and returned; contract complete.
closing.fail: Day {DAY} at {WORLD}: Recovery contract failed; canister not recovered in time.

find.success: Day {DAY} at {WORLD}: Canister located and scooped successfully.
find.targetDestroyed: Day {DAY} at {WORLD}: Target system lost to catastrophe; recovery impossible.
find.failed: Day {DAY} at {WORLD}: Recovery attempt failed before canister could be scooped.

home.success: Day {DAY} at {WORLD}: Canister delivered and contract fulfilled.
home.failed: Day {DAY} at {WORLD}: Return journey failed; canister not delivered.
